useCase.name: Run the reports against the accounting records, so the books can be read, checked and closed from one place

intent.name: report.accounting.run
intent.summary: Run an accounting report — the general ledger by account, the trial balance, journals, income and expenditure, budget against actual, the voucher register — for the account, date range and branch the reader sets. Against the ledger, and it changes nothing.
routesHere: run the trial balance for the year to date

routesHere.gloss: give last month's income and expenditure statement

routesElsewhere.note: The fee ledger answers what families owe; these reports answer what the school's books say (BR-3, AC-9).

request.gloss: the trial balance isn't balancing, adjust it

routesElsewhere.note: It is produced from the ledger and never adjusted to balance. Where it does not balance, that is the finding (BR-10, E5).

routesElsewhere.goesTo: finance.voucher.create — UC-04-19, as a further entry.
routesElsewhere.note: A wrong entry is corrected by a further entry where it was posted, never from the report (BR-7, E6).

routesElsewhere.note: The books' own ledger read, with tracing. It reads the same ledger as the catalogue report; both are live.

routesElsewhere.note: Statutory and compliance reporting is not in MVP.

routesElsewhere.note: A report is taken away by the one output route, never by a route of its own (BR-9).

request.gloss: I need the combined report of all branches

routesElsewhere.goesTo: report.combined.run — UC-24-19, the Super Admin alone.
routesElsewhere.note: Every report here is scoped to the branch. One figure across branches is run by the Super Admin, and cannot be given to anybody else.

steps.note: One read, against the ledger (BR-3). The run is recorded (BR-8).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Without the permission, a date range or a chart of accounts, nothing runs. A trial balance that does not balance is shown as it is.
plan.atomicity: A read. It changes nothing (BR-7); the only write is the record of the run (BR-8).

operations.name: report.accounting.run
operations.purpose: Run an accounting report from the catalogue against the ledger.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No accounting report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's accounting group: General ledger by account and date range; Trial balance; Journals; Income and expenditure; Budget against actual; Voucher register. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: period
parameters.notes: The date range the report covers (BR-2). Set by the reader, never assumed (E3).

parameters.name: account_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No account in the chart of accounts matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching accounts with their codes.

parameters.notes: The account, where the report is scoped to one (BR-2).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: balances
fields.description: On the trial balance: whether the two columns agree. Never adjusted to agree (BR-10).

fields.name: difference
fields.description: Where the trial balance does not balance, by how much (E5).

fields.name: approvals
fields.description: On the voucher register: the approvals recorded on each voucher (BR-6).

fields.name: variance
fields.description: On budget against actual: the difference between the two.

errors.meaning: The reader does not hold the permission for this report.
No chart of accounts is set up.
errors.notWritten: No accounting report can be run.
errors.note: Nothing in the specification creates one (OQ-2).

errors.meaning: The trial balance does not balance.
errors.note: Shown as it is, with the difference stated. That is the finding (BR-10).

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-8).

planningRules.rule: Never assume the date range. Ask where the request gives none — the reader sets it before the report runs, and a report run over the wrong period is read as though it were the right one.
Never adjust the trial balance or explain the difference away. It is produced from the ledger, and where it does not balance the difference is the finding (BR-10, A3, E5, AC-3).
A School Admin reads budget against actual for the spending they control, and not the ledger generally — the general ledger is not offered to them (BR-4, A2, AC-5).
Show the approvals on the voucher register. That is why the Super Admin reads it (BR-6, A1, AC-4).

Say that what a branch-scoped figure means is not decided. Whether branches keep separate ledgers or one ledger with a branch on each entry is unresolved, and it changes what a branch's trial balance says (BR-5, OQ-1).
Say that a figure for a past period can still move. Nothing closes a period, so the same report run tomorrow may differ (OQ-4).
Never correct anything from a report. A wrong entry is corrected by a further entry where it was posted (BR-7, E6, AC-6).
Report an empty result as an answer, not a failure.
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19. There is no route out of its own (BR-8, BR-9).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone.

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-8).
